title: LifePatch — Outro Recap (verdict-keyed)
key: A minor (warm/major on a good verdict)
licenseNotes: Original. Warm major-6 extension (good) or minor tension (bad) over the shared A-minor cycle; no third-party material.
sourceNotes: Procedural; phase `recapGood`/`recapBad` of src/audio/AudioEngine.ts. WIRED: components/cinematic/Outro.tsx quantizes the recap film onto this grid via hooks/useBeatClock — every scene cut lands on a BAR (3.157895s), snapped cumulatively so rounding cannot drift, with each scene's accent requested ACCENT_PREROLL_MS (120ms) early so it detonates on the cut. The authored scene lengths (2200/3000/3800/4200ms plus the years replay) were already within half a bar of one, so the film's total runtime is unchanged. The year replay's atoms are beat subdivisions (a 16th per year, a dotted 8th of extra dwell on a milestone), so an uncompressed replay is on the grid by construction; runs long enough to need compressing fall back to proportional scaling. The verdict split-flap locks each character on the 16th grid (the glyph churn stays at 55ms — that blur is texture, not rhythm), which also self-throttles the mechanical clacks to one per 16th.
